# Coherent histories across retained and changing contexts

<!-- Generated by build_result_registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

> Pooling the steps of an inhabited family of processes runs exactly the courses of single processes exactly where those courses compose; retaining the context runs exactly them, and forgetting a context that changes with the step is exact precisely where every context can follow each forgotten step.

<a id="主张-claim"></a>
## Claim

For an inhabited family of processes on common configurations, the pooled law (a step some member takes, the context forgotten) runs exactly the courses some single member runs exactly where courses of single members compose: a course of one context followed by a course of one context is a course of one context. Retaining the context, each configuration carrying its context and each step keeping it, runs exactly the courses of that context, and so realizes exactly the courses of single contexts. Where context and configuration change together by one relation, forgetting the context is exact from every context exactly where every context can follow each forgotten step; the contexts a course arrives in are those its last step advances to from the contexts its earlier part arrives in. Witnesses: one context steps 0 to 1 and another 1 to 2; pooling runs 0 to 2, which no single context runs, so the family is not closed under joining and retaining the context excludes the crossing; a context changing with the step joins the two in one course, which ends at 2, and the forgotten law takes a step the given context cannot follow.

Canonical source: [Context.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Context.lean)

- Common state and event interpretations, a nonempty process family for the pooling equivalence, finite inductive Trace and actual boundary matching.
- The evolving construction supplies a joint relation on context and displayed conditions. Logical framework and correspondence remain explicit; no normative, totality or favorable-direction premise.

Context denotes consequential relations within one unfolding, not an independently constituted controller. Semantic support need not be an implemented observer belief.

## Validation and boundaries

Machine-checked in the core: every cited declaration of Becoming.ContextArrivalTraces and Becoming.Context, the ending included, has an empty axiom report in the bound receipts. The periphery's earlier form (BecomingCompatibility) used propext for the ending.

Finite conditional coherence, not universal actual law, physical mechanism, infinite-path coverage, ethical warrant or zero-substantive-axiom grounding. The lifting criterion has a stronger specified-initial-context scope than family-union exactness. Existential context support is not quantum control coherence; no operational correspondence to the switch comparison is proved.

- Pooling 0→1 from one context and 1→2 from another runs 0→2, which no single context runs, so pooling is not exact there. A context changing with the step joins the two in one course, which ends at 2.
